title: Citation
description: Citation element with three presentation modes.

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: what the citation applies to (default sibling)

attributes.name: creator
attributes.description: author / creator name (attribute is creator, not author)

example_html: <citation-element creator="Cool Joe" license="by" title="Te Futr Da Biz" source="https://duckduckgo.com/" date="03/07/2020"></citation-element>
agent_notes: license-name/license-link/license-image are auto-derived from the license key; an incoming author value is mapped to creator.
